blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The August 29 public-rank goal is unmet, the iOS 1.0.1 crash still lacks a symbolicated diagnostic report, and Open-Meteo promotion clearance is not attached. The Play conversion read is above target as reported, but its denominator must be reconciled before it can support a decision.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. Store publishing, external outreach, and any spend remain explicit action-time approval steps.

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · obtain report, symbolicate, fix, re-smoke
gate_snapshot.evidence: App Store Connect shows one iOS 1.0.1 crash on 2026-08-25, but device detail is insufficient and no crash report/stack is exposed for symbolication or root-cause verification.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Obtain the Organizer or diagnostic report, symbolicate, reproduce, fix, and re-smoke

gate_snapshot.decision: PENDING · send clarification and record the answer
gate_snapshot.evidence: Clarification email is drafted but has not been sent or answered
gate_snapshot.next_action: Send through an authenticated sender and record an unambiguous written response

gate_snapshot.decision: PARTIAL · signed API 25 phone matrix passes; tablet/widget/Wear remain
gate_snapshot.evidence: Signed phone 1.1.0 (7) passed physical API 25 clean install, live forecast, cold start, denied-location fallback, manual search, share, 150% text, TalkBack, cached-network fallback/recovery, contextual review-prompt dismissal/no immediate repeat, exact APK/signing identity, and cleanup. A scheduled cache refresh passed on the earlier debug candidate; physical tablet, widget, and Wear OS remain incomplete.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Run the signed RC on physical tablet, widget, and Wear OS; keep background evidence scoped to its tested artifact

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · unlock iPad; reconnect iPhone and mount DDI
gate_snapshot.evidence: The exact Apple 1.1.0 (5) archive installed on a physical iPad but launch was blocked by the device lock and the app was removed; the earlier 1.0.1 (4) Release passed bounded physical iPad provider/cache/widget/cold-launch paths. The required iPhone is currently unavailable; its previous connection had no mountable DDI.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Unlock the iPad and reconnect the iPhone, mount DDI, then run the remaining signed physical matrix

query.description: Loads the complete required goal surfaces from the fixed public-rank capture while preserving bounded absences; one auxiliary Apple query is incomplete.
